inventory.title: Equipment
inventory.attunementInfoText:
Some magic items only work once a character attunes to them. A character can be attuned to no more than 3 items at a time.

The counter shows how many equipped items require attunement. They are marked with a dot on the figure. Mundane gear and magic items that don't require attunement don't count.
inventory.twoHandedBlocked: Blocked: main hand has a two-handed weapon
